title: Al bar: ordering a drink and a snack
theme: Café drinks and snacks in Italy
essentialQuestion: Come posso ordinare qualcosa al bar?
canDo: I can name common café drinks and snacks when I see them on a menu.
I can order one item with a memorized polite phrase.
I can ask how much something costs.
I can thank the person who helped me.
structures: Vorrei… (I would like…) — a fixed polite chunk, not a conjugation pattern
Quanto costa? (How much does it cost?)
cultureNote: In Italy a bar is usually a café. How people order and pay is not the same everywhere: some places ask you to pay at the cassa first, and others bring il conto after you finish. It helps to watch what others do, or to ask.
